title: Gezhe Village cemetery-relocation campaign and related public actions
notes: Secret China body says the relocation campaign began in late September. It reports >100 villagers at the construction site on 9 October and a >100-person march to township government/police station on 11 October; the latter also protested arrests. These October actions are continuations of the September-start campaign, not newly started October candidates. Core video account is attributed to Yesterday Protests/X; independent origin remains unresolved.
open_questions: Confirm the prior-month owner and campaign onset from contemporary source material; verify how distinct 9 and 11 October actions relate to the September campaign.
